title: Pick For Us proposed Data safety decision matrix
method: Reuse hash-bound audit and observed evidence; targeted official documentation refresh; no Android trace or Console submission
owner_unknowns: Final published variants and runtime provider-role basis
Final exact answer attestation; no renewed generic operational questionnaire

known_owner_attestations.quote: Right now, no, but it'll be something we work towards.
known_owner_attestations.scope: No separate copies/exports outside normal local storage, Vercel dashboards and Gmail; owner statement, not forensic proof
Personally handles support/privacy mail; delete after resolution subject to legitimate legal/security retention; mailbox bot access disabled

rows.flow: Unrounded returned GPS -> app server -> Nominatim / independent Overpass operators
rows.confidence: High source; Android runtime not witnessed
rows.closure_needed: Verify precise grant behavior, payloads, provider processing/retention. If valid exception later established, change Shared only; collection remains.

rows.flow: Coarse GPS plus automatic analytics geography
rows.proposed_shared: Yes for optional coordinate transfers; Vercel role unresolved
rows.proposed_user_control: Required at combined category level because analytics is automatic
rows.proposed_ephemeral: No for retained analytics; location-provider path unverified

conditional.condition: Only if actual Vercel processing counts as sharing after role/exception assessment

rows.confidence: High on observed country aggregates; medium on specific Android flows
rows.closure_needed: Do not treat optional GPS as opt-out from automatic IP-derived geography. Confirm Vercel implementation and whether any other provider infers location.

rows.flow: Entered place text -> app server -> Nominatim
rows.proposed_user_control: Optional, subject to usable GPS/default alternative validation
rows.closure_needed: Validate all-user choice and final query retention. No stored history list is necessary for this category. Do not automatically call destination text personal Address.

rows.flow: Automatic production pageviews; Mode Selected instrumentation exists
rows.proposed_shared: HOLD: Vercel service-provider basis plausible but not established for all processing
rows.confidence: High on pageviews, low on custom-event intake
rows.closure_needed: No-events/upgrade dashboard does not certify Mode Selected intake. Confirm actual payload and relevant service role.

rows.flow: Vercel request-derived visitor hash; potential Grok device/security cookies
rows.proposed_collected: Yes proposed for analytics visitor identification
rows.proposed_shared: HOLD; Yes if Grok identifying cookies are sent without a qualifying exception
rows.proposed_ephemeral: No for visitor session; Grok retention/purpose unresolved
rows.confidence: Medium mapping; no Android cookie trace
rows.closure_needed: Resolve hash relationship to browser/device and cookie acceptance/retransmission; do not infer cookie purpose from name. Add Security only if substantiated; do not invent Advertising purpose or AAID collection.

rows.flow: Request/provider outcome, duration/mirror summaries in hosting logs
rows.proposed_user_control: Required when the relevant operation runs
rows.confidence: Medium: logs observed, category boundary requires field review
rows.closure_needed: Confirm user/device-related diagnostic fields versus solely server operational records. No crash-reporting SDK or crash logs asserted.

rows.flow: Potential external referrer/site-visit information in analytics/resource request headers
rows.proposed_collected: Conditional; do not select from mere own-app page routes
rows.proposed_shared: HOLD; recipient and exception depend on observed flow
rows.closure_needed: Capture actual referrer behavior; own-app interactions stay DS04. Do not infer all browsing history or arbitrary browsing access.

rows.category: IP / request metadata: classify by usage
rows.flow: Google Fonts request; Grok extension download; Vercel hosting requests
rows.proposed_collected: Off-device requests established; categories depend on usage
rows.confidence: High on request integration, medium/low on provider usage
rows.closure_needed: IP is not its own form category. Do not automatically double-count it as Device IDs or Location. Provider-wide ad-cookie lists/CSP destinations do not prove actual advertising data flow.

rows.category: Local favorites, ratings, visits/notes, exclusions, preferences, legal-notice dismissal
rows.flow: On-device store/session storage only in reviewed paths
rows.closure_needed: Selected location reused for server requests remains DS01/02; evaluate Android backup/transfer separately. Reset does not erase all data.

rows.flow: User opens Maps, rideshare or venue website
rows.proposed_collected: Do not add user physical Location solely for public venue coordinates
rows.proposed_shared: Proposed exception for expected user-directed destination transfer, conditional UI/runtime validation
rows.confidence: High helper source; native dispatch untested
rows.closure_needed: Validate exact handoff, no extra automatic source GPS or identifiers; external app independent collection differs from app-controlled resource loading.

rows.flow: PR77 mailto opens external email client with operator recipient and generic subject
rows.proposed_collected: No solely from mailto; conditional if app actually collects/transmits user content
rows.proposed_shared: No additional declaration solely from this mailto; reassess integrated upload/composition
rows.proposed_ephemeral: No for actual retained support mail
rows.confidence: High source boundary; actual native mail-client experience untested
rows.closure_needed: User-composed external email is disclosed in policy, but not evidence that Pick For Us transmits the sender/body. No support-bot processing assumed; personally managed Gmail deletion after resolution attested.

rows.category: Name / Email / User IDs from accounts
rows.flow: Dormant auth/OAuth/database scaffolding; no visible account creation
rows.proposed_collected: No affirmative selection on dormant code alone; conditional if reachable account flow exists
rows.closure_needed: Check deployed configuration and routes without creating accounts. Do not assert no historical records.
